title: Adult Children of Emotionally Immature Parents
author: Lindsay C. Gibson
summary: A psychologist describes four types of emotionally immature parents and the effects on their grown children. She offers ways to recognize these patterns, set boundaries and build healthier relationships.
readIf: you grew up feeling unseen by a parent and want language for it and steps to heal.
skipIf: you prefer research-heavy psychology over a plainly written self-help approach.
